description: This Java class is an implementation of SelfBeneficiariesTPTReadPlatformService, providing methods to retrieve beneficiary and account template data related to self-service beneficiaries in a financial application, primarily interacting with a database through JDBC.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements data retrieval for self-beneficiaries related to transfer platform, including methods for listing beneficiaries, account templates, and transfer limits. Uses nested classes to map SQL query results.

methods.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTReadPlatformServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing context, jdbcTemplate, and row mappers.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all self-beneficiaries for the authenticated user.

methods.name: retrieveTPTSelfAccountTemplateData
methods.description: Retrieves TPT self-account template data for a given user.

methods.name: getTransferLimit
methods.description: Returns the transfer limit for a specified user, account, and account type.
